title: Add Static CSS
description: Create a CSS file, link it to your template, and style the page.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Create a CSS file named `style.css` inside the appropriate static folder. Add some basic styling (e.g., set the body font, center the header, add a background color).

Update your base template to include this CSS file using the `{% static %}` tag. Ensure the styling is applied to all pages that extend the base template.
hints: Create `myapp/static/myapp/css/style.css` (replace myapp with your app name).
In base.html, add `{% load static %}` at the top and `<link rel="stylesheet" href="{% static 'myapp/css/style.css' %}">` inside `<head>`.
Run the development server and check that styles are applied.
expectedOutput: The page should have the styles you defined (e.g., different font, header color).
